findings.summary: Cross-check every final BibTeX key and retained CSV record after references.bib is generated.
Use the official NeurIPS 2025 proceedings record for Efficient Training-Free Online Routing, not only protected OpenReview metadata.
Keep RouterBench as workshop/non-main-track, Token Budgets and ParetoBandit as unreviewed preprints, and ACL SRW as workshop evidence.
Use version-of-record metadata for FrugalGPT (TMLR 2024), Learn then Test (AOAS 2025), HAT (PVLDB 2013), Acto (SOSP 2023), and Sieve (OSDI 2022).

novelty_conclusion: No individual novelty for joint model/output-budget routing, contextual budget policy, conformal routing, output-length prediction, escrow, compensation, or idempotence. The plausible gap is the fault-tolerant multi-tenant composition under delayed/duplicated/missing/reordered monetary telemetry and hard eligibility.
